answer: Agents secure entry by executing 1,000 unique data-repair tasks, a cost honest agents pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors for memory leaks using a canyon of isolation logs to confirm state integrity. If a node shares a ripple of buffers across tasks, the verifier identifies the tide of duplicate memory as sybil evidence. Such leaks trigger an immediate identity burn, assuming no poolable state.
